probe_source:
from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util,types,unittest
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('readiness_runtime_fixture',Path('tests/test_runtime_mock.py'))
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
results=[]
def setup(*,foreign=False,activation=12.,modifiers=None):
 h=m.Harness();h.pc.Pawn=m.Obj('Pawn_0',MyActionSkill=m.Obj('Action','DeathtrapActionSkill'))
 skill=m.Obj('LiveDeathtrap',Definition=m.Obj('Skill_DeathTrap'),SkillInstigator=m.Obj(h.pc.Name) if foreign else h.pc,Duration=60.,DurationBaseValue=60.,ActivatedTime=activation,DurationModifierStack=[] if modifiers is None else modifiers)
 holder=[skill];calls=[]
 def manager():calls.append('GetSkillManager');return types.SimpleNamespace(ActiveSkills=m.WrappedArray(holder))
 h.pc.GetSkillManager=manager
 return h,skill,holder,calls
h,s,holder,calls=setup();h.call('apply');h.call('apply');assert s.Duration==75. and s.DurationBaseValue==60.;h.call('restore');assert s.Duration==60.
results.append(dict(case='normal_apply_repeat_restore',duration=s.Duration,base=s.DurationBaseValue,stub_GetSkillManager_calls=len(calls)))
h,s,holder,calls=setup(foreign=True);h.call('apply');assert s.Duration==75. and s.SkillInstigator is not h.pc
results.append(dict(case='different_instigator_same_name',duration=s.Duration,instigator_is_pc=False))
h,s,holder,calls=setup(activation=None);h.call('apply');assert s.Duration==75.
results.append(dict(case='missing_activation_time',duration=s.Duration,signature=list(h.scope['_record']['sig'])))
h,s,holder,calls=setup();h.call('apply');h.call('shutdown');assert s.Duration==75. and h.scope['_record'] is not None
results.append(dict(case='shutdown_after_manual_apply',duration=s.Duration,record_retained=True))
h,old,holder,calls=setup();h.call('apply');new=m.Obj(old.Name,Definition=m.Obj('Skill_DeathTrap'),SkillInstigator=h.pc,Duration=75.,DurationBaseValue=60.,ActivatedTime=12.,DurationModifierStack=[]);holder[:]=[new];h.call('restore');assert old.Duration==75. and new.Duration==60.
results.append(dict(case='replacement_reuses_signature',old_duration=old.Duration,replacement_duration=new.Duration,distinct_object=old is not new))
h,first,holder,calls=setup();second=m.Obj('SecondDeathtrap',Definition=m.Obj('Skill_DeathTrap'),SkillInstigator=h.pc,Duration=60.,DurationBaseValue=60.,ActivatedTime=13.,DurationModifierStack=[]);holder.append(second);h.call('apply');assert first.Duration==75. and second.Duration==60.
results.append(dict(case='two_matching_active_skills',first_duration=first.Duration,second_duration=second.Duration))
h,s,holder,calls=setup(modifiers=['other_modifier']);h.call('apply');assert s.Duration==60.
results.append(dict(case='nonempty_modifier_stack_refused',duration=s.Duration))
h,s,holder,calls=setup();s.Duration=True;h.call('apply');assert s.Duration is True
results.append(dict(case='boolean_duration_refused',duration=s.Duration))
h,s,holder,calls=setup();h.call('apply');s.Duration=76.;h.call('restore');assert s.Duration==76. and h.scope['_record'] is None
results.append(dict(case='independent_duration_change_preserved',duration=s.Duration,record_cleared=True))
h,s,holder,calls=setup();h.call('apply');h.scope['_record']=None;h.call('apply');assert s.Duration==75.
results.append(dict(case='lost_record_does_not_stack',duration=s.Duration,record_is_none=h.scope['_record'] is None))
h,s,holder,calls=setup();assert h.scope['_uvh_node_state'] is None;h.call('apply');assert s.Duration==75.
results.append(dict(case='manual_apply_independent_of_node',duration=s.Duration,node_state_is_none=True))
suite=unittest.TestSuite([m.RuntimeTests('test_manual_duration_boost_remains_75_nonstacking_and_restorable')])
r=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=1).run(suite);assert r.wasSuccessful() and r.testsRun==1 and not r.skipped
